title: hinglish-profanity wordlist
description: One wordlist per locale. Terms describe how offensive a word is; they never describe what to do about it.

lang.description: Which locale this list covers. hi-deva is matched before transliteration.

phrases.description: Multi-word entries, matched across token boundaries.

excluded.description: Documentation only. Words deliberately NOT treated as profanity (sentiment, not profanity). Never loaded at runtime.

term.description: Canonical spelling, reported as Match.term. It is normalized the same way as input before comparison (so 'lund' is stored as-is and compared as 'iund'); detect(term) must report the term itself at index 0.

severity.description: How offensive the WORD is. 4 = sexual/incest abuse and slurs, 3 = strong profanity, 2 = crude but common, 1 = mild/tone only. Never a statement about confidence, and never an instruction to block.

wholeTokenOnly.description: Only match as a complete token, never inside a longer word. Required for short stems: 'ass' in 'assignment', 'gand' in 'Gandhi'.

ambiguous.description: The term collides with innocent usage ('bc' = before Christ, 'laura' = a name). Matches on it are reported with confidence: 'low'.

note.description: Why this entry is tricky. Documentation only; never used at runtime.
